title: A caravan blocks the road
description: The driver shouts at his oxen. The road is narrow, and you'd have to push or talk your way past.

onPass.narration: You shoulder the wheel free; the merchant tips you in gratitude.

onFail.narration: You strain but the wheel won't move. The merchant shrugs.

choices.text: Talk him into letting you detour.

onPass.narration: He laughs and waves you onto a hidden path. He even tosses a small purse.

onFail.narration: He waves you off, returning to his oxen.

onPass.narration: Two hours later, the road clears. You've used some of your supplies.
